title: Psalm 36 (Thy Mercy, O Lord)
lyrics_original: Therefore men shall put their trust
In the shade of Thy wings.
Thou shalt make them to drink
Therefore men shall put their trust
In the shade of Thy wings.
Thou shalt make them to drink

bible_verses.english: Your loving kindness, Yahweh, is in the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
Your righteousness is like the mountains of God. Your judgments are like a great deep. Yahweh, you preserve man and animal.
He loves righteousness and justice. The earth is full of the loving kindness of Yahweh.

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, my heart marvels today at the vastness of Your mercy and the depth of Your faithfulness. Thank You for loving me with a grace higher than the clouds and stronger than the mountains. When life feels uncertain, help me to anchor my soul in Your excellent lovingkindness. I choose to put my trust fully in You today, resting under the shadow of Your tender wings. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: When we look up at the endless sky or gaze at towering mountains, we get a glimpse of God’s boundless love and unwavering faithfulness. His righteousness is unshakeable, and His mercy knows no limits. In Jesus, this vast lovingkindness came down to meet us in our need. As you sing these words, let your heart rest in the quiet assurance that the One who holds the heavens holds your life with steady, unfailing grace.
